name: Electricity; at user; generation mix - Uruguay

processDocumentation.completenessDescription: No elementary flows. Completeness of the generation mix is that of the upstream at-grid process; this process only adds T&D losses.
processDocumentation.dataCollectionDescription: The World Bank indicator 'Electric power transmission and distribution losses (% of output)' (EG.ELC.LOSS.ZS), from the World Development Indicators, was accessed on August 7 2026.
processDocumentation.dataSelectionDescription: Latest transmission and distribution loss year less than or equal to the linked at-grid mix year. Geographic region fallback if no country series; omit if neither is available.
processDocumentation.dataTreatmentDescription: Static loss factor applied as a gross-up. L = 0 is kept (amount = 1). L >= 1 is rejected.
processDocumentation.geographyDescription: End use in Uruguay. T&D loss factor is for this country (URY).
processDocumentation.intendedApplication: End-use (at user) electricity demand in the country, linked to the U.S. Electricity Baseline via the country at-grid mix and a U.S. 120 V low voltage proxy.
processDocumentation.inventoryMethodDescription: Technosphere only: 1 MJ low voltage out; high voltage in from the country at-grid process at 1 / (1 - L).
processDocumentation.modelingConstantsDescription: L is the World Bank indicator 'Electric power transmission and distribution losses (% of output)' (EG.ELC.LOSS.ZS), expressed as a fraction of output. Amount on the high voltage input is 1 / (1 - L).
